headline: Code Kunst taps BTS's Jung Kook for 6th album 'Prankstar'
sub: Jung Kook features on double title track 'Love is Blind'

points.title: What to know
items: 'Love is Blind' features Jung Kook of BTS
Guests incl. Crush, WOODZ, Colde, DAY6's Young K
First full album in about 3 years

source: Source: Duo Over Entertainment via Korean media
caption:
Producer Code Kunst is back with his 6th full album 'Prankstar' — and BTS's Jung Kook is on it.

The 14-track album drops Dec 3 at 6 PM KST with a double title: 'Prankstar (Feat. DPR IAN)' and 'Love is Blind (Feat. Jung Kook of BTS)'. Crush, WOODZ, Colde, DeVita, Joyce Wrice and DAY6's Young K also join. It's his first full album in about three years, built around the joking TV persona and the life behind it.

📌 Source: Duo Over Entertainment (via Korean media)
